description: Replace the list of websites allowed to show this account's player and chat iframes, for example the company website so nobody else can embed the stream. This REPLACES the whole list: call get_embed_domains first and send the full list you want to keep. Entries: example.com, www.example.com or *.example.com (scheme and port are ignored), at most 50. An empty list allows every website, so do not send an empty list unless the user wants that. The list belongs to the account and applies to all its streams and videos. Confirm with the user before changing it.

domains.description: Full list of allowed websites, e.g. ["intranet.company.com", "*.company.com"]

name: set_embed_domains
title: Set allowed embed domains
